response.query: Which privacy-preserving video pipelines (on-device keypoint extraction, automatic face-blurring, tiered consent/raw-video access) best balance analytic needs and cross-jurisdictional legal constraints?
response.answer: On-device keypoint extraction and automatic face-blurring with tiered consent best balance analytics and legal privacy. These methods keep data local and provide user control over access.

results.content: # Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning for Multimedia and Edge Information Processing The advancements and progress in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning, and the numerous availabilities of mobile devices and Internet technologies together with the growing focus on multimedia data sources and information processing have led to the emergence of new paradigms for multimedia and edge AI information processing, particularly for urban and smart city environments. The advancements and progress in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning [1,2], and the numerous availabilities of mobile devices and Internet technologies together with the growing focus on multimedia data sources [3] and information processing techniques [4] have led to the emergence of new paradigms for multimedia and edge information processing, particularly for urban and smart city environments [5,6,7]. This paper aims to survey these new paradigms for AI and machine/deep learning for multimedia and edge information processing from several perspectives. Chen, J.; Li, K.; Deng, Q.; Li, K.; Yu, P.S. results.title: USENIX Security '25 Technical Sessions
results.content: With a systematic evaluation of diverse methods, our study provides actionable insights into the utilty-privacy tradeoffs of synthetic data generation methods and guides the decision on optimal data releasing strategies for real-world applications. In our evaluation against 15 real-world Java web applications, WDFuzz achieved a 92.6% recall rate in the known vulnerability dataset, finding 3.2 times more vulnerabilities and detecting them 7.1 times faster than the state-of-the-art web fuzzer. In this paper, we design and implement the first framework, called JAEX, to automatically detect and exploit Java Web Application vulnerabilities via concolic execution guided by so-called Cross-thread Object Manipulation. We develop GlitchFHE, an analytical framework that guides toward such adversarial security assessment of FHE applications against FIAs. We run through a set of timely and relevant case studies, covering established applications like image processing, neural networks, and polynomial evaluation, for the prominent CKKS and BFV schemes, both at the analytical/software level and the physical/real-world level.

results.title: Counsel, Code, and Credibility: An Evidence-Based ...
results.content: # Counsel, Code, and Credibility: An Evidence-Based Narrative on AI’s Transformation of Legal Work. ## How Generative AI Is Reshaping the Legal Profession: Evidence-Based Insights on Efficiency Gains, Risk Management, Governance Gaps, and the Future of Legal Service Delivery. I begin with a clear thesis: **Generative AI** — software that produces content (text, images, etc.) by learning patterns from large data [1] — is reshaping legal work in measurable but uneven ways. In my assessment, today’s AI in law acts less like a robot lawyer replacement and more like an augmented legal assistant, accelerating tedious tasks (e.g. document review, research) and enhancing human decision-making [2], [3]. ## The hype of fully autonomous “AI attorneys” is misplaced, as practical experience shows that human lawyers remain essential gatekeepers for accuracy, judgment, and professional responsibility [3]. At the same time, dismissing AI outright would ignore evidence of significant efficiency and quality gains in…. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
